div.div: Q. Q. 1 زَحْوَلَهُ عَنْ مَكَانِهِ He made him, or it, to slip (أَزَلَّهُ, [probably a mistranscription for أَزَالَهُ he removed him, or it, like as زَلَّ is put in some copies of the K in the place of زَالَ in a case mentioned above,]) from his, or its, place. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
